stage: Validation-driven frozen-feature head refinement, before any new320 evaluation
reason: Three teacher epochs reach validation score0.4607, below student0.6026. Optimize the new task heads on fixed encoder features before judging transfer.
normalization: Mean/std from training features only; std clamped at0.02; fold into final linear weights and biases
optimizer: Full-batch Adam; classifier weights LR0.01, biases LR0.03
loss: sqrt capability weights CE +0.5 inverse-intent CE +L2 averaged by class groups
selection: Unchanged v4 optimization score; keep initial model if no improvement
mobile_precision_gate: Quantized head inputs/weights/biases with FP32 accumulation must stay within0.1 absolute logits on validation; not a whole-graph or phone check
distillation_gate: Best teacher must exceed best mobile student validation score by0.02
data_rules: Same frozen train/validation. No fresh-test text, targets or examples used in fit; original nine targets unchanged
